claims.statement: The included configuration.txt has SHA-256 digest a23f1f55d9a914cff49fb6ba369b9f392f7af4c5ce08085267b3af1e7d7742c4 and decodes to a 152-point no-three-in-line subset C of G_76. It is invariant under a quarter turn, its dihedral orbit has exactly two distinct images, and translating those images by the four vectors in {0,1}^2 gives exactly eight distinct embeddings E in G_77. For each of those eight E, every cell of G_77 minus E is blocked by at least two distinct unordered pairs of E; deleting any one point of E frees no originally outside cell; deleting any unordered pair frees at most one originally outside cell; and exactly 16 deletion pairs per E free one cell. Consequently, every no-three-in-line S in G_77 with |E minus S| at most 2 has |S minus E| at most 1 and |S| at most 152; hence |S| at least 153 implies |E minus S| at least 3, |S minus E| at least 4, and symmetric difference at least 7. This claim concerns only those eight embeddings, not arbitrary record configurations or the global value of D(77).

root/record-152-verification.summary: Maintain replayable exact-integer verification of the 152-point configuration in G_76 and its embedding in G_77, while distinguishing local or governed executions from any claim of optimality or an improved bound.

root/record-152-verification/governed-re.title: Governed replay and artifact audit of the 152-point certificate
root/record-152-verification/governed-re.summary: The included configuration.txt has SHA-256 digest a23f1f55d9a914cff49fb6ba369b9f392f7af4c5ce08085267b3af1e7d7742c4 and is byte-for-byte identical to the certificate in canonical transaction dfc0cc40d41105292a119840dcdbe6f22860cf43. The included verify.py has SHA-256 digest 43463d0207199ef42ae0dc9c88c67f855fd92b070fb8d007f477a6b2de1998ec. Executing python3 -I -B verify.py configuration.txt on these bytes decodes exactly 152 distinct points in G_76, exhaustively checks all 573,800 unordered triples with exact integer determinants, finds no collinear triple, and exits successfully; hence the bytes re-certify D(77) at least 152. The included verification.json requests a governed replay of that exact predicate but does not assert a hosted outcome before its separate attestation is published. No improved bound, optimality, or exact value of D(77) is claimed. Successful execution is established by the separate terminal attestation, not by verification.json itself.

root/record-152-verification/lower-bound.title: Replay-certified lower bound D(77) ≥ 152
root/record-152-verification/lower-bound.summary: The accepted exact-integer replays certify 152 distinct points in G_76 with no collinear triple; embedding G_76 into G_77 establishes D(77)≥152. This re-verifies the existing lower bound and establishes no improved bound, optimality, or exact value of D(77). Acceptance of pinned bytes by a governed execution is distinct from the mathematical audit of the encoded predicate, and a verification request does not itself pre-assert a hosted outcome.
